desc.zh: 孙翊被残忍杀害，跟随徐氏一同追寻
desc.en: Sun Yi has been brutally slain, follow Xu Shi in pursuit

desc.zh: 和徐氏一同押送边洪回城。
desc.en: Escort Bian Hong back to the city with Xu Shi.

if.zh: [个人战][舌战][论战]结果 = 胜利

desc.zh: 和徐氏讨论事情的可疑之处
desc.en: Discuss the suspicious aspects with Xu Shi

story.zh: 孙翊离奇被害，凶手逃入山中逍遥法外，孙翊之妻徐氏誓要为夫报仇雪恨...
story.en: Sun Yi has been mysteriously murdered, and the culprit has fled into the mountains to escape justice. Sun Yi's wife, Lady Xu, vows to avenge her husband...

forbidden.zh: 主角为徐氏，孙翊，边洪，戴员，伪览时无法触发。
forbidden.en: Cannot trigger if protagonist is Lady Xu, Sun Yi, Bian Hong, Dai Yuan, or Gui Lan.

participate.zh: 【与徐氏的关系等级至少为2级】
participate.en: 【Relationship level with Lady Xu is at least Level 2】

defy.zh: 【帮助徐氏报仇，并使徐氏成为家将】
defy.en: 【Help Lady Xu take revenge, and recruit Lady Xu as Retainer】

conditions.en: Xu Shi is not the player's wife

if.zh: [个人战][舌战][论战]结果 = 胜利
